title: Device-lab mission
description: One mission for the device lab: which APK, which emulator, which world, which reality steps, which Maestro flows. Lives at tools/e2e/native/<app>/redesign/missions/<id>.yaml. Checked by tools/e2e/native/check-missions.mjs, which also checks what a schema cannot: the id equals the file name and is unique, the app matches the folder, every referenced file exists, and every dev-scenario name is one devworld knows. How to write one: tools/e2e/native/README.md.

id.description: Kebab-case, unique across every mission, equal to the file's base name. Ids starting with example- are examples the lab may skip.

avd.description: The emulator image the APK goes on: hg_customer for the customer app, hg_rider for the rider app.

api.description: devworld: the local services/hg after make dev-reset. mock: pnpm mock on :4010.

setup.description: Commands run from services/hg before the flows, in order. Only these forms are allowed.

reality.description: Reality steps, applied in order by tools/e2e/reality/apply-mission.mjs. Each item has exactly one key.

geo-route.description: A GPX file under tools/e2e/native/routes/, played back at its own timestamps (about 1 Hz) in the background.

lock.description: true turns the screen off (KEYCODE_POWER); false wakes it and dismisses the keyguard.

background-ms.description: Send the app home, wait this long, bring it back to the front.

camera-media.description: A file under tools/e2e/native/media/, pushed to /sdcard/Pictures and media-scanned so the photo library shows it.

flows.description: Maestro flows run in order, under tools/e2e/native/<app>/redesign/ and never under missions/.

build.description: Optional: how the lab builds the dev APK for this mission. env sets build-time public variables (EXPO_PUBLIC_* only, inlined into the bundle, so the lab clears the Metro cache when it sets any); note is free text for the lab. Without build, the lab builds the redesign APK with EXPO_PUBLIC_HG_REDESIGN=1.

explore.description: Optional free-form instructions for the lab agent to explore with maestro mcp or mobile-mcp, screenshotting every state it reaches.
